name: gweni
description: GUI Without Extravagant Nonsense: a retained-mode C++17 GUI library whose controls keep their renderer primitives and update only what changed (OpenGL 3.3 core, WebGL 2, Vulkan 1.3)

opengl.description: The OpenGL renderer, renderer::OpenGLCore (GWENI_RENDER_OPENGL_CORE): OpenGL 3.3 core through glew natively, WebGL 2 on the web

vulkan.description: The Vulkan 1.3 renderer, renderer::Vulkan (GWENI_RENDER_VULKAN), its shaders compiled to SPIR-V by the host's glslangValidator

app.description: The app shell gweni::app (GWENI_BUILD_APP): app::Window (a GLFW window natively, WebGL 2 in a page through Emscripten's contrib.glfw3 port) and app::Headless (surfaceless EGL natively)
